name: SAPHFIRE_A_Phenolic_Furanoid
description: SAPHFIRE 2026 smoldering plan, Solution A: expected ppb per compound for 43.32 uL (SAPHFIRE_injection_smoldering_150ppb.xlsx, 2026-07-06); amounts = ppb per uL of solution

components.name: 2(3H)-Furanone
components.note: '2(3h)-furanone' is not an MCM species — no furanone in the MCM

components.name: Furan
components.note: 'furan' is not an MCM species — suggested surrogate M3F (3-methylfuran is the only furan in the MCM)

components.name: Guaiacol
components.note: 'guaiacol' is not an MCM species — suggested surrogate MCATECHOL (methylcatechol, same formula C7H8O2, phenolic with two oxygens)

components.name: 2-furfural
components.note: '2-furfural' is not an MCM species — no furan aldehyde in the MCM; M3F keeps the ring, C4ALDB the conjugated aldehyde

components.name: 5-(hydroxymethyl)-2-furfural
components.note: '5-(hydroxymethyl)-2-furfural' is not an MCM species — no furan aldehyde in the MCM; low volatility, mostly on the walls/particles

components.name: 2-methylfuran
components.note: '2-methylfuran' is not an MCM species — suggested surrogate M3F (3-methylfuran: same formula C5H6O, the only furan in the MCM)

components.name: 2-furanmethanol
components.note: '2-furanmethanol' is not an MCM species — no furan alcohol in the MCM; M3F keeps the ring

components.name: 5-methyl-furfural
components.note: '5-methyl-furfural' is not an MCM species — no furan aldehyde in the MCM; M3F keeps the ring

components.name: Creosol
components.note: 'creosol' is not an MCM species — suggested surrogate MXYCATECH (dimethylcatechol, same formula C8H10O2)

components.name: 2,5-dimethylfuran
components.note: '2,5-dimethylfuran' is not an MCM species — suggested surrogate M3F (3-methylfuran keeps the furan ring)

components.name: Eucalyptol (1,8-cineole)
components.note: '1,8-cineole' is not an MCM species — no MCM analogue; slow OH loss
